header: "How to read a BH mark": the mark is typed (or arrives from the search line) and I explain each part: the year, BH, the number and the letters. Under the reading comes the literature (BhGuide.tsx). It is computed in the browser from src/tools/bh/bh.ts; nothing typed is stored or sent.
